query:
WITH RECURSIVE date_range("date") AS (
                      VALUES(DATE(DATE(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'localtime') - '365 day'))
                      UNION ALL
                      SELECT DATE("date", '+1 day')
                      FROM
                        date_range
                      WHERE
                        "date" <= DATE(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'localtime')
                    )
                    SELECT SUM(d.points_weighted) / SUM(d.weight) AS "value: f64"
                    FROM
                      date_range dr
                    LEFT JOIN
                        "dailies" d
                    ON
                        d.date = dr.date
                    WHERE
                        user = $1
                        AND points IS NOT NULL
                    GROUP BY
                        dr.date
                    ORDER BY
                        dr.date DESC
                    LIMIT 365;
